# Test hasBreak with range stmt and nested break
mv F:/BEGIN/+0,/END/-0 New
-- x.go --
package p

func F(items []int) {
	total := 0
	// BEGIN
	for _, v := range items {
		if v < 0 {
			break
		}
		total += v
	}
	// END
	_ = total
}
